File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 1. registers and logs in a test user
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 2. rejects unauthenticated upload with 401 or 403
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 3. uploads a small audio file and receives a storage key
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 4. downloads the uploaded file and verifies content-type and byte payload
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 5. cross-user access to a file is rejected (403) or not found (404)
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 6. deletes the uploaded file and returns success
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 7. GET of a deleted file returns 404
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 8. delete of a completely unknown file key returns 401, 403, or 404
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 9. GET /api/storage/quota returns quota info when authenticated
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 10a. double-encoded traversal in file key is rejected (never 200)
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 10b. literal '..' segments in file key are rejected (never 200)
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 10c. backslash and encoded-NUL keys are rejected (never 200)
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 10d. restore of the deleted file makes it downloadable again
File Management (Storage Round-Trip) > 10. GET /api/storage/quota returns 401 or 403 without authentication
